rounds.text: Geojit Financial Services demonstrates superior capital efficiency, consistently outperforming sector benchmarks with an ROA of 3.31% against 1.92% [E8], an ROE of 6.69% against 4.9% [E9], and an ROCE of 8.77% against 5.33% [E10]. The company maintains a fortress balance sheet, evidenced by a conservative debt-to-equity ratio of 0.10x [E37] and a significant reduction in total borrowings from Rs 156 Cr to Rs 123 Cr [E39]. Financial health is further underscored by robust cash generation, with a 2.81x cash conversion ratio ensuring that reported profits are fully backed by actual cash flow [E34]. Strategic reinvestment is currently underway, as indicated by a 350% increase in capital work in progress, signaling a deliberate build-up phase for future growth [E40]. Conceded: the company faces headwinds from a 48% decline in trailing twelve-month profit growth [E21], a reduction in promoter holding [E41], and a valuation that appears rich relative to discounted cash flow models [E45]. Despite these challenges, the firm’s ability to maintain a 2.12% dividend yield [E4] while simultaneously funding internal expansion highlights a disciplined approach to capital allocation.
